results.title: OXAGEN
results.content:
However, there might be some mild side effects, such as nausea, cramping, fatigue, anxiety and bloating. It is essential to control dosages per day and do not prolong course of OXAGEN for more than 8 weeks. Just like for most of steroid preparations we advise to perform post cycle therapy (PCT). Typical prescribed drugs for PTC after OXAGEN are Clomid and Nolvadex. Recovery is short-termed.  
   
 OXAGEN may may suppress Hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis, even if taken in insignificant quantities. Therefore, PCT is a must. Like any other steroid does, OXAGEN may affect liver and kidney even if insignificantly overdosed. [...] What does OXAGEN consist of?  
   
 OXAGEN (Oxandrolone) is a structurally altered dihydrotestosterone hormone. Carbon-2 and Methylation, typical of DHT, is replaced by an oxygen atom in Oxandrolone. It is more potent derivative of DHT. In classification it is C17-aa steroid. It is one of the most used synthetic testosterone (including Anadrol, Dianabol and Winstrol).  
   
 Side Effects  
   
 As we have previously noted, OXAGEN is unlikely to give severe side effects, as it does not aromatase. [...] OXAGEN (Anavar) is an outstanding oral steroid that suits both men and women.  
   
 It is often viewed as a mild steroid, and we cannot deny that it`s applicable to many purposes due to its mildest side effects. Nevertheless, OXAGEN is extremely effective both as a bulking supplement and as a cutting one.  
   
 OXAGEN is usually misunderstood by men aiming at mass gain, however most will find enormous value in its strength enhancing effect.  
   
 Oxandrolone, the active substance, is an anabolic and mildly androgenic agent .
